title: Mixed-autonomy traffic 的安全與 emergent risk
statement: 在人駕與自動車混合的交通流中，控制策略如何降低局部衝突而不產生system-level instability或風險轉移。
known_result: 2026 Scientific Reports提出digital-twin/anticipatory risk-field方法處理mixed-autonomy交通的stochastic interactions。
open_gap: human-driver model misspecification、penetration rate、rare interactions與network-level spillovers。
first_task: 用toy ring-road/microscopic simulator比較reactive vs anticipatory controller，做driver-behaviour OOD sweep。
validation_limits: 模擬TTC改善不等於道路事故因果降低；不部署真實交通控制。
completion_criterion: 跨driver models/penetration rates保持safety-throughput Pareto改善，且無hidden risk displacement。
screening_note: 2026-09-28 初始有界文獻篩查。每輪重新查最新版本、實驗條件與失敗案例；simulation成果不得寫成已安全部署。
screening_queries: mixed autonomy traffic digital twin safety 2026

sources.title: Engineering proactive risk fields in mixed-autonomy traffic via anticipatory swarm intelligence: a digital twin perspective
